description: User's livebook run: replace-unlockable-candidates path called create_new_log_workers without the insufficient_nodes guard; with node_capabilities.log momentarily empty (registration timing on a booting node), assign_workers_to_nodes hit rem(0,0) -> ArithmeticError -> director crash. Converged via crash+restart, but a stall ({:insufficient_nodes, n, 0}) is the honest behavior. Guard moved into create_new_log_workers so every caller is safe. Also renamed 'unlockable' (reads as able-to-be-unlocked) to 'lock-failed' throughout.
title: Ghost replacement stalls on zero log-capable nodes instead of crashing (rem/0)
